user.title: Connect to Grocy
user.description: Enter a Grocy address that Home Assistant can reach directly. App ingress URLs are not supported.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to Grocy
reauth_confirm.description: The current API key was rejected. Enter a replacement key.

reconfigure.title: Update Grocy connection
reconfigure.description: Update the Grocy address or authentication settings.

error.invalid_auth: The Grocy API key was rejected
error.invalid_url: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS Grocy URL

abort.already_configured: This Grocy server is already configured

product_name_ambiguous.message: More than one Grocy product is named {product_name}. Use a barcode or product ID.

invalid_auth_runtime.message: Grocy rejected the configured API key. Reauthenticate the integration.

invalid_response_runtime.message: Grocy returned an unexpected response. No stock was changed.

cannot_connect_runtime.message: Unable to complete the Grocy lookup. No stock was changed.

location_not_found.message: No usable Grocy stock location could be resolved. No stock was changed.

catalogue_location_not_found.message: Grocy location {requested} was not found exactly. Available locations: {available}. Nothing was changed.

location_ambiguous.message: This product is stocked in more than one possible location. Choose a location; no stock was changed.

insufficient_stock.message: The selected location does not contain enough stock. No stock was changed.

request_id_conflict.message: That request ID was already used for a different transaction. No new stock change was made.

barcode_conflict.message: That barcode already belongs to a different Grocy product. Nothing was changed.

quantity_unit_not_found.message: Grocy quantity unit {requested} was not found exactly. Available quantity units: {available}. Nothing was changed.

catalogue_outcome_unknown.message: Grocy may have saved part of the product setup, but the result could not be verified. Reconcile the product before trying again.

voice_confirmation_not_found.message: That voice confirmation has expired or was already used. Ask again; no stock was changed.

voice_candidate_not_allowed.message: That product was not one of the offered voice matches. No stock was changed.

voice_alias_conflict.message: That voice alias belongs to more than one product or is already assigned elsewhere. Correct the voice_aliases values in Grocy; no stock was changed.

voice_alias_field_missing.message: Create a products userfield in Grocy named voice_aliases before learning aliases. Use a single-line or multi-line text field. No stock was changed.

voice_alias_outcome_unknown.message: Grocy may have saved the voice alias, but the result could not be verified. Check the product's voice_aliases userfield before trying again.

merge_outcome_unknown.message: Grocy may have merged the products, but the full result could not be verified. Do not retry with a new request ID until the target product, source product, stock, barcodes, and voice aliases have been reconciled.
